Does a Bayesian analysis make peeking safe?** These sources disagree. - Deng, Lu & Chen (2016) prove that Bayesian testing stays valid under continuous monitoring when the stopping rules are "proper." They also flag common improper practices. https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.05549 - Georgiev (2016, updated 2019) argues that outcome-based stopping inflates error for Bayesian tests too. Azevedo et al. show that this is optimal only when idea quality has thin tails. They measure "extremely fat tails" at Bing, where a lean strategy of many smaller tests is preferred (https://eduardomazevedo.github.io/papers/azevedo-et-al-ab.pdf).
